item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible evidence that Hasina used domestic-crisis powers to primarily protect civilians or suppress violence while preserving peaceful dissent.\nI also did not find evidence of a non-coercive, law-bound crisis doctrine comparable to restorative policing or rights-protective emergency management.\nThe strongest available “on the other side” material is limited to de-escalation after protests collapsed, not an initial protective response.","evidence":[{"title":"Bangladesh blocks roads and internet, deploys army to curb protests","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 20, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-blocks-roads-and-internet-deploys-army-to-curb-protests/2183179/","summary":"Soldiers patrolled Dhaka, roadblocks went up, and internet/text services were suspended during the crackdown; this is coercive spectacle and censorship, not protection or restraint.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.5","3B.6","3B.8","3B.1","2B.4"]},{"title":"Bangladesh PM Hasina blames opposition for violence, curfew to remain","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 22, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladesh-pm-hasina-blames-opposition-for-violence-curfew-to-remain-3528153","summary":"Hasina kept the curfew in place and blamed political opponents for the violence, which reads as selective punishment and political fear management rather than crisis protection.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.3","3B.5","3B.6","3B.8","2B.6"]},{"title":"Bangladesh’s crackdown on protesters left more than 170 dead, U.N. says","publisher":"United Nations / OHCHR","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://bangladesh.un.org/en/275065-bangladesh-t%C3%BCrk-decries-government-crackdown-urges-respect-international-human-rights","summary":"The UN said more than 170 people had been killed and warned that internet shutdowns increase impunity; that strongly supports the conclusion that the state response was abusive rather than protective.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.6","2B.4","2B.9"]},{"title":"Bangladesh security forces target unarmed students","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"July 22, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/22/bangladesh-security-forces-target-unarmed-students","summary":"HRW reported security forces targeting unarmed students alongside Awami League-affiliated activists; this is direct evidence against a restraint-based response to a spontaneous flare-up.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.1","3B.2","3B.8","2B.4","2B.5"]},{"title":"Bangladesh prime minister Hasina resigns amid mass protests","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"August 6, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/06/bangladesh-prime-minister-hasina-resigns-amid-mass-protests","summary":"HRW described extrajudicial killings, enforced disappearances, and attacks on protesters during the crackdown; this is strong evidence that the crisis response amplified violence rather than suppressing it.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.1","3B.2","3B.8","2B.4","2B.9"]},{"title":"Bangladesh restores internet as students call off job-quota protests","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 29, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladesh-restores-internet-as-students-call-off-jobquota-protests-3540555","summary":"Internet service was restored only after protesters called off the movement and conditions were said to be normalizing; this is the closest counterevidence, but it looks reactive and coercion-driven rather than a proactive protection strategy.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.5","3B.6"]},{"title":"Exclusive: Bangladesh army refused to suppress protest, sealing Hasina's fate","publisher":"Reuters","date":"August 7, 2024","url":"https://www.voanews.com/a/exclusive-bangladesh-army-refused-to-suppress-protest-sealing-hasina-s-fate/7733166.html","summary":"The army refused to open fire on civilians to enforce Hasina’s curfew; this is weak counterevidence showing a coercive option was resisted by the military, but it does not show Hasina herself chose restraint.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","2B.9"]},{"title":"Bangladesh repression, security force abuses discredit elections","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"January 11, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/bangladesh-repression-security-force-abuses-discredit-elections","summary":"HRW reported arrests for criticism and widespread repression before the election, showing the year began with a punitive climate already in place.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.1","3B.2","2B.4","2B.5"]}]}
